model_selection_note: Owner-selected on 2026-11-11: use GPT-6.1 Sol for all three pilot roles. Keep the shared model and role reasoning settings fixed for the first few assignments, then evaluate evidence quality, missed errors, and correction burden before changing them. If unavailable in the execution environment, report the limitation rather than silently substituting another model.
escalation_policy: Increase effort for consequential ambiguity, conflicting evidence, or integration conflicts within the assignment boundary; record changes and affected work. Do not substitute an unsupported model or effort setting silently.
actual_settings_policy: Record requested and actual model/effort separately. If the actual value is not exposed, record unknown with the reason rather than inferring it from this configuration.
execution_policy: One researcher/reviewer/steward worker executes at a time. Coordinator may wait, monitor completion and report status, but performs no concurrent census work. Configuration records intent, not runtime proof.
